Let $v_A$ and $v_B$ be the normalized additive valuations of $A$ and $B$, with values in $\mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$, and let $e$ be the ramification index of the maximal ideal of $B$ over $A$. nodes.title: Additive valuations scale by the ramification index

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be discrete valuation rings with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_A$, $\mathfrak m_B$, and let $B$ be an $A$-algebra that is torsion-free as an $A$-module and whose structure map is a local homomorphism. Let $e$ be the ramification index of $\mathfrak m_B$ over $A$. Then for every $x \in \mathfrak m_A$, the image of $x$ in $B$ lies in $\mathfrak m_B^e$.
nodes.title: Images of the base maximal ideal lie in the ramification power

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a discrete valuation ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak{m}$ and normalized additive valuation $v \colon R \to \mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$. For every $x \in R$, the multiplicity of $\mathfrak{m}$ in the principal ideal $(x)$, that is, the supremum in $\mathbb{N} \cup \{\infty\}$ of the $n \in \mathbb{N}$ such that $\mathfrak{m}^n$ divides $(x)$ as ideals, equals $v(x)$.
nodes.title: Multiplicity of the maximal ideal equals the additive valuation

nodes.summary: Let $R$ and $S$ be Dedekind domains, with $S$ an $R$-algebra that is finitely generated and torsion-free as an $R$-module, and let $n$ be the rank of $S$ as an $R$-module. If $\mathfrak{p}$ is a maximal ideal of $R$ and $\mathfrak{q}$ is a prime ideal of $S$ lying over $\mathfrak{p}$, then the inertia degree $f_{\mathfrak{q}}$ of $\mathfrak{q}$ over $\mathfrak{p}$ satisfies $1 \le f_{\mathfrak{q}} \le n$.
nodes.title: Bounds on the inertia degree

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a commutative local ring and let $p$ be the characteristic of its residue field. For every natural number $n$, the image of $n$ in $R$ is a unit if and only if $p$ does not divide $n$.
nodes.title: Natural numbers that are units in a local ring

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be discrete valuation rings with maximal ideals $\mathfrak m_A$, $\mathfrak m_B$, and let $B$ be an $A$-algebra that is torsion-free as an $A$-module and whose structure map is a local homomorphism. Let $e$ be the ramification index of $\mathfrak m_B$ over $A$. Then the ideal $\mathfrak m_A B$ of $B$ generated by the image of $\mathfrak m_A$ equals $\mathfrak m_B^e$.
nodes.title: The extended maximal ideal is a power of the maximal ideal

nodes.summary: Let $R$ and $S$ be Dedekind domains, with $S$ an $R$-algebra that is finitely generated and torsion-free as an $R$-module, and let $n$ be the rank of $S$ as an $R$-module. If $\mathfrak{p}$ is a maximal ideal of $R$, then the number $g_{\mathfrak{p}}$ of prime ideals of $S$ lying over $\mathfrak{p}$ satisfies $1 \le g_{\mathfrak{p}} \le n$.
nodes.title: Bounds on the number of primes above a prime

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
